data.name: Padmanabh
data.gender_notes: Padmanabh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Padmanabh is derived from two Sanskrit words - Padma (lotus) and Anabh (navel). This name is used to describe Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have the universe within his navel in Hindu mythology. The name Padmanabh carries the meaning “Lord of the Lotus Navel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Padmanabh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the lotus navel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine connection between the creator and the creation, representing the cosmic consciousness.
data.etymology: Padmanabh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Lotus Navel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Padmanabh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Padmanabh is deeply rooted in Indian culture, having its origin in Hindu mythology. Lord Vishnu, one of the primary deities in Hinduism, is known by this name. The name reflects the cosmic significance of Lord Vishnu, who is depicted as reclining on the cosmic ocean with the universe contained within his navel. The name Padmanabh is hence, a symbol of divinity, power, and creation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Padmanabh signifies the belief in the cosmic order and the cyclic nature of the universe. The name is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings and the immense power of the divine creator. Furthermore, it reflects the Hindu concept of Brahman, the ultimate reality and creator of the universe, being present in all beings and things. The name Padmanabh serves as a reminder of the importance of staying connected to the divine and maintaining a spiritual perspective in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Padmanabh: The divine name symbolizes the presence of Lord Vishnu, the preserver, in the form of a lotus (Padma) in one's belly (Nabh). It signifies the purification of the soul and the attainment of supreme consciousness.

vedic_reference.note: Padmanabha is a form of Lord Vishnu, and is mentioned in the Vedas as 'the one with the lotus navel'. The Padmanabh Temple in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, is dedicated to this form of Lord Vishnu.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Padmanabh was a king of the Chalukya dynasty in the 11th century. The name Padmanabh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Padmanabh remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Rahul Padmanabh, a teacher in Delhi, India, shares that their name Padmanabh meaning "Lord of the Lotus Navel" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
